title: Firm Ownership and Pollution
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: We provide a theoretical micro foundation for how much pollution (negative externalities) a firm will internalize based on the ownership distribution of its shareholders. Small shareholders, compared to large ones, want the firm to spend more on avoiding pollution since they suffer less profit loss for the same environmental benefit. In particular, if a shareholder holds a share of 1/N, where N is the population in society, that shareholder's preferences align with a social planner's.Three theoretical predictions arise. First, small shareholders will systematically vote for a greener corporate profile. Second, firms with a smaller weighted median shareholder will pollute less. Third, countries with concentrated corporate wealth holdings and/or more individualized firm ownership pollute more. This implies that standard models of externalities in environmental economics and macroeconomics containing representative agents are either internally inconsistent or not fully specified.
abstract_zh: 我们从理论上为企业将在多大程度上内部化污染（负外部性）提供了微观基础，该程度取决于其股东的所有权分布。与大股东相比，小股东更希望企业在避免污染方面投入更多，因为对于相同的环境收益，他们承受的利润损失更小。特别地，若某股东持有的股份为1/N（N为社会总人口数），则该股东的偏好与社会计划者的偏好一致。理论预测有三点。第一，小股东会系统性地投票支持更环保的企业形象。第二，加权中位股东持股较小的企业污染更少。第三，企业财富高度集中和/或企业所有权更加个人化的国家污染更严重。这意味着，环境经济学和宏观经济学中包含代表性行为人的标准外部性模型，要么内在不一致，要么设定不完整。

title: An Evaluation of Protected Area Policies in the European Union
abstract: The European Union designates 26% of its landmass as a protected area, limiting economic development to favor biodiversity. This paper uses the staggered introduction of protected-area policies between 1985 and 2020 to study the selection of land for protection and the causal effect of protection on vegetation cover and nightlights. Our results reveal protection did not affect the outcomes in any meaningful way across four decades, all countries, protection cohorts, and a wide range of land and climate attributes. We conclude that European conservation efforts lack ambition because policymakers select land for protection not threatened by development.
abstract_zh: 欧盟将其26%的陆地面积划为保护区，以限制经济开发、促进生物多样性保护。本文利用1985年至2020年间保护区政策的交错实施，研究土地被选择用于保护的机制，以及保护对植被覆盖和夜间灯光的因果效应。我们的结果表明，在四十年间、所有国家、各保护批次以及广泛的土地和气候特征条件下，保护政策对上述结果均未产生任何实质性影响。我们的结论是，欧洲的保护努力缺乏雄心，因为决策者选择用于保护的土地本就不受开发威胁。

title: The Efficiency of Electricity Prices
Cancelling Carbon in Cap-and-Trade Systems
How (Not) to Cancel Carbon in the EU ETS: Germany's Coal Phase-out
Optimal Local Transit Pricing with Distributional Concerns
What is the Role of Hybrids in Vehicle Climate Policy?
A View of the Sustainable Computing Landscape
abstract: This article presents a holistic research agenda to address the significant environmental impact of information and communication technology (ICT), which accounts for 2.1%-3.9% of global greenhouse gas emissions. It proposes several research thrusts to achieve sustainable computing: accurate carbon accounting models, life cycle design strategies for hardware, efficient use of renewable energy, and integrated design and management strategies for next-generation hardware and software systems. If successful, the research would flatten and reverse growth trajectories for computing power and carbon, especially for rapidly growing applications like artificial intelligence. The research takes a holistic approach because strategies that reduce operational carbon may increase embodied carbon, and vice versa. Achieving these goals will require interdisciplinary collaboration between computer scientists, electrical engineers, environmental scientists, and economists.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一项综合性研究议程，以应对信息与通信技术（ICT）对环境造成的重大影响，该行业占全球温室气体排放的2.1%至3.9%。文章提出了实现可持续计算的若干研究方向：准确的碳核算模型、硬件的全生命周期设计策略、可再生能源的高效利用，以及下一代硬件和软件系统的综合设计与管理策略。如果研究取得成功，将可以使计算能力和碳排放的增长轨迹趋于平缓并逆转，尤其是对于人工智能等快速增长的应用。本研究采取整体性视角，是因为降低运营碳排放的策略可能会增加隐含碳排放，反之亦然。要实现这些目标，需要计算机科学家、电气工程师、环境科学家和经济学家之间的跨学科合作。

title: Designing More Cost-Effective Trading Markets for Renewable Energy
abstract:
In this paper we study the design of renewable energy portfolio standards (RPSs). We focus on solar energy and analyze two common RPS rules: cross-state trading restrictions and state-specific interim annual targets. Using historically observed RPSs and an empirically calibrated model of state-level solar supply curves, we find that allowing for cross-state trading reduces cost by one-fifth and significantly changes the geographic distribution of new solar installations. Removing interim annual targets over the 2015 to 2019 period reduces cost by one-third by back-loading installations to later years. These cost reductions become much larger when considering more ambitious RPS targets. Our results suggest that more flexible program design such as allowing for cross-state trading, back-loading interim targets, or banking and borrowing renewable energy credits can avoid escalating costs and preserve the political feasibility of renewable energy standards, although such cost savings must be balanced against the social damages from delayed climate action and other economic and political considerations.
JEL Classification:
H23, Q41, Q42, Q48
abstract_zh:
本文研究可再生能源组合标准（RPS）的设计。我们聚焦于太阳能，分析两种常见的RPS规则：跨州交易限制和各州特定的阶段性年度目标。利用历史上实际实施的RPS以及基于实证校准的州级太阳能供给曲线模型，我们发现，允许跨州交易可将成本降低五分之一，并显著改变新增太阳能装机的地理分布。取消2015年至2019年期间的阶段性年度目标，通过将装机推迟至后期，可将成本降低三分之一。当考虑更雄心勃勃的RPS目标时，这些成本节约效果会大得多。我们的结果表明，更灵活的政策设计，例如允许跨州交易、推迟阶段性目标，或允许可再生能源证书的存储与借用，可以避免成本攀升，并维持可再生能源标准在政治上的可行性，尽管此类成本节约必须与气候行动延迟所造成的社会损害以及其他经济和政治考量相权衡。
JEL分类号：
H23, Q41, Q42, Q48

title: Overlapping Climate Policies
abstract: The world is under pressure to deliver on the 2015 Paris Climate Agreement. Individual jurisdictions are enacting policies such as phasing out coal, taxing aviation, and supporting renewable energy. These often overlap with a wider multi-jurisdictional carbon-pricing system like the EU's Emissions Trading System. We develop a general framework to study how such "overlapping climate policies" can help combat climate change-depending on their design, location and timing. Some policies are truly complementary while others backfire by raising aggregate emissions. At a conceptual level, our model encompasses most carbon-pricing systems used in practice and a wide range of popular unilateral policies.
abstract_zh: 世界正面临兑现2015年《巴黎气候协定》承诺的压力。各司法管辖区正在实施诸如淘汰煤炭、对航空征税以及支持可再生能源等政策。这些政策往往与欧盟排放交易体系等范围更广的多司法管辖区碳定价体系相互重叠。我们构建了一个一般性框架，研究此类“重叠气候政策”如何有助于应对气候变化——其效果取决于政策设计、实施地点和时机。部分政策确实具有互补性，而另一些政策则会因推高总排放量而适得其反。从概念层面看，我们的模型涵盖了实践中使用的大多数碳定价体系，以及多种流行的单边政策。

title: Agency Frictions and Procurement: New Evidence from U.S. Electricity Restructuring
The Environmental Impacts of Protected Area Policy
abstract: The world has pledged to protect 30 percent of its land and waters by 2030 to halt the rapid deterioration of critical ecosystems. We summarize the state of knowledge about the impacts of protected area policies, with a focus on deforestation and vegetation cover. We discuss critical issues around data and measurement, identify the most commonly-used empirical methods, and summarize empirical evidence across multiple regions of the world. In most cases, protection has had at most a modest impact on forest cover, with stronger effects in areas that face pressure of economic development. We then identify several open areas for research to advance our understanding of the effectiveness of protected area policies: the use of promising recent econometric advancements, shifting focus to direct measures of biodiversity, filling the knowledge gap on the effect of protected area policy in advanced economies, investigating the long-run impacts of protection, and understanding its equilibrium effects.
abstract_zh: 世界各国承诺到2030年保护30%的陆地和水域，以遏制关键生态系统的快速退化。我们总结了保护区政策影响的研究现状，重点关注森林砍伐和植被覆盖。我们讨论了数据与测量方面的关键问题，明确了最常用的实证方法，并归纳了世界多个地区的实证证据。在大多数情况下，保护政策对森林覆盖的影响至多是适度的，而在面临经济开发压力的地区，其影响较强。随后，我们指出了若干有待开展的研究领域，以深化对保护区政策有效性的理解：运用近期有前景的计量经济学进展，转向直接测度生物多样性，填补发达经济体中保护区政策效果的知识空白，考察保护的长期影响，以及理解其一般均衡效应。

title: Has Consumer Acceptance of Electric Vehicles Been Increasing? Evidence from Microdata on Every New Vehicle Sale in the United States
abstract: Electric vehicle (EV) sales have been rapidly growing around the world, spurred by technology advances and policy actions. This study leverages rich data on all individual new light-duty vehicles sold in the United States from 2014 to 2020. We examine how EV attributes, prices, and sales have evolved, exploring substantial heterogeneity across geography, vehicle class, price range, and demographics. We use a matching analysis to compare EVs to similar conventional vehicles to find that EVs have been surprisingly competitive in very recent years. This suggests that constrained supply is an important determinant of the low overall EV market share.
abstract_zh: 在技术进步和政策行动的推动下，全球电动汽车（EV）销量迅速增长。本研究利用了2014年至2020年间在美国售出的所有个体新型轻型车辆的丰富数据。我们考察了电动汽车的属性、价格和销量是如何演变的，并探讨了其在地理、车辆类别、价格区间和人口特征方面存在的显著异质性。我们采用匹配分析，将电动汽车与相似的传统燃油车进行比较，发现电动汽车在最近几年竞争力出人意料地强。这表明，供给受限是电动汽车整体市场份额较低的一个重要决定因素。

title: Regulating Untaxable Externalities: Are Vehicle Air Pollution Standards Effective and Efficient?
abstract: The world has 1.4 billion passenger vehicles. How should governments regulate their air pollution emissions? A Pigouvian tax is technologically infeasible. Most countries instead rely on exhaust standards that limit air pollution emissions per mile for new vehicles. We assess the effectiveness and efficiency of these standards, which are the centerpiece of US Clean Air Act regulation of transportation, and counterfactual policies. We show that the air pollution emissions per mile of new US vehicles has fallen spectacularly, by over 99 percent, since standards began in 1967. Several research designs with a half century of data suggest that exhaust standards have caused most of this decline. Yet exhaust standards are not cost-effective in part because they fail to encourage scrap of older vehicles, which account for the majority of emissions. To study counterfactual policies, we develop an analytical and a quantitative model of the vehicle fleet. Analysis of these models suggests that tighter exhaust standards increase social welfare and that increasing registration fees on dirty vehicles yields even larger gains by accelerating scrap, though both reforms have complex effects on inequality.
abstract_zh: 全球有14亿辆乘用车。政府应如何监管其空气污染排放？庇古税在技术上不可行。大多数国家转而依赖尾气标准，即限制新车每英里的空气污染排放量。我们评估了这些标准的有效性和效率，它们是美国《清洁空气法》对交通运输实施监管的核心，同时也评估了若干反事实政策。我们表明，自1967年标准实施以来，美国新车每英里的空气污染排放量已大幅下降，降幅超过99%。利用半个世纪数据的若干研究设计表明，尾气标准是这一下降的主要原因。然而，尾气标准并不具备成本效益，部分原因在于它未能激励淘汰老旧车辆，而老旧车辆贡献了大部分排放。为研究反事实政策，我们构建了车队的解析模型和定量模型。对这些模型的分析表明，更严格的尾气标准会提高社会福利；而提高高排放车辆的登记费，则可通过加速报废带来更大的收益，尽管这两项改革对不平等都有复杂的影响。

title: Formative Experiences and the Price of Gasoline
abstract: Formative experiences shape behavior for decades. We document a striking feature about those who came of driving age during the oil crises of the 1970s—they drive less in the year 2000. The effect is not specific to these cohorts; price variation over time and across states indicates that gasoline price changes between ages 15–18 generally shift later-life travel behavior. Effects are not explained by recessions, income, or costly skill acquisition and are inconsistent with recency bias, mental plasticity, and standard habit-formation models. Instead, they likely reflect formation of preferences for driving or persistent changes in its perceived cost. (JEL D12, D91, L71, Q35, R41)
abstract_zh: 成长过程中的经历会塑造数十年的行为。我们记录了一个显著特征：在20世纪70年代石油危机期间达到驾驶年龄的人群，在2000年的驾驶里程更少。这一效应并非仅限于这些队列；跨时间和跨州的汽油价格变动表明，15至18岁期间汽油价格的变化，通常会改变其日后的出行行为。这些效应无法由经济衰退、收入或代价高昂的技能习得来解释，也与近因偏差、心理可塑性和标准习惯形成模型不一致。相反，它们很可能反映了对驾车偏好的形成，或对其感知成本的持久改变。（JEL D12, D91, L71, Q35, R41）

title: How Do Climate Risks Affect the Interactions Between Financial Markets and Energy Companies?
Consumer Myopia in Vehicle Purchases: Evidence from a Natural Experiment
abstract: A central question in the analysis of fuel economy policy is whether consumers are myopic with regards to future fuel costs. We provide the first evidence on the consumer valuation of fuel economy from a natural experiment that provides exogenous variation in fuel economy ratings. We examine the short-run equilibrium effects of a restatement of fuel economy ratings that affected 1.6 million vehicles. Using the implied changes in willingness to pay, we find that consumers act myopically: consumers are indifferent between $1.00 in discounted fuel costs and $0. 16–0.39 in the purchase price when discounting at 4 percent. This undervaluation persists under a wide range of assumptions. (JEL D12, L62, L71, L11)
abstract_zh: 燃油经济性政策分析中的一个核心问题是，消费者对未来燃油成本是否短视。我们利用一个提供燃油经济性评级外生变异的自然实验，首次给出了消费者对燃油经济性估值的证据。我们考察了一次燃油经济性评级重新公布事件的短期均衡效应，该事件影响了160万辆车。利用隐含的支付意愿变化，我们发现消费者表现出短视行为：当贴现率为4%时，消费者认为折现后1.00美元的燃油成本与0.16至0.39美元的购车价格无差异。这种低估在广泛的假设条件下依然存在。（JEL D12, L62, L71, L11）

title: When Does Regulation Distort Costs? Lessons from Fuel Procurement in US Electricity Generation: Comment
abstract: We revisit one of the results in Cicala (2015) and show that the previously estimated large and significant effects of US electricity restructuring on fuel procurement are not robust to the presence of outliers. Using methodologies from the robust statistics literature, we estimate the effect to be less than one-half of the previous estimate and not statistically different from zero. The robust methodology also identifies as outliers the plants owned by a single company whose coal contracts were renegotiated before discussions about restructuring even started. (JEL D83, O13, O33, Q16)
abstract_zh: 我们重新审视了Cicala（2015）的一项结果，并表明此前估计的美国电力重组对燃料采购的较大且显著的影响，在存在异常值的情况下并不稳健。运用稳健统计文献中的方法，我们估计该效应不到原估计值的一半，且与零无统计显著差异。稳健方法还将某一家公司所拥有的电厂识别为异常值，该公司的煤炭合同在重组讨论开始之前就已重新谈判。（JEL D83, O13, O33, Q16）

title: Estimating the Costs and Benefits of Fuel Economy Standards
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy
abstract: Fuel-economy standards for new vehicles are a primary policy instrument in many countries to reduce the carbon footprint of the transportation sector. These standards have many channels of costs and benefit, impacting sales, composition, vehicle attributes, miles traveled and externalities in the new-car fleet, as well as the composition and size of the used fleet. We develop a tractable analytical framework to examine the welfare effects of fuel-economy standards, and apply it to the recent government proposal to roll back fuel-economy standards. We find that our combined, multi-market vehicle choice model implies that the proposal would increase the size of the vehicle fleet over time, and also generates smaller welfare gains than models with a less rich structure of the vehicle market, such as the one used in the analysis associated with the 2018 Notice of Proposed Rulemaking (NPRM) announcement. The disparities across the two models appear to result from the absence of feedback effects in the NPRM analysis. We stress the importance of instead using a multi-market vehicle choice model to provide the most accurate predictions of costs and benefits. We also derive bounds that can serve as a check on the theoretical consistency of such analyses, and that offer insights into the magnitudes of potential errors resulting from imperfect multi-market integration.
abstract_zh: 新车燃油经济性标准是许多国家降低交通运输部门碳足迹的主要政策工具。这些标准通过多种渠道产生成本和收益，影响销量、车型结构、车辆属性、行驶里程以及新车队的外部性，并影响二手车队的构成与规模。我们构建了一个易于处理的解析框架，考察燃油经济性标准的福利效应，并将其应用于政府近期提出的放松燃油经济性标准的方案。我们发现，我们结合多个市场的车辆选择模型表明，该方案将随时间推移扩大车队规模，而且所带来的福利收益也小于那些车辆市场结构较简单的模型，例如2018年《拟议规则制定通知》（NPRM）所采用的模型。两种模型之间的差异似乎源于NPRM分析中缺乏反馈效应。我们强调，应当改用多市场车辆选择模型，以对成本和收益作出最为准确的预测。我们还推导了一些界限，可用于检验此类分析的理论一致性，并揭示由多市场整合不完善所可能导致的误差大小。

title: The Use of Regression Statistics to Analyze Imperfect Pricing Policies
abstract: Corrective taxes can solve many market failures, but actual policies frequently deviate from the theoretical ideal because of administrative or political constraints. We present a method to quantify the efficiency costs of constraints on externality-correcting policies or, more generally, the costs of imperfect pricing, using simple regression statistics. Under certain conditions, the R2 and the sum of squared residuals from a regression of true externalities on policy variables measure relative welfare gains from policies. We illustrate via four empirical applications: random mismeasurement of externalities, imperfect electricity pricing, heterogeneity in the longevity of energy-consuming durable goods, and imperfect spatial policy differentiation.
abstract_zh: 矫正性税收可以解决许多市场失灵问题，但由于行政或政治约束，实际政策常常偏离理论上的理想状态。我们提出了一种方法，利用简单的回归统计量，量化外部性矫正政策受到约束时的效率损失，或更一般地，量化不完全定价的成本。在特定条件下，以政策变量对真实外部性进行回归所得的R²和残差平方和，可以衡量政策带来的相对福利收益。我们通过四个实证应用加以说明：外部性的随机测量误差、不完全的电力定价、耗能耐用品使用寿命的异质性，以及不完全的空间政策差异化。

title: What Policies Address Both the Coronavirus Crisis and the Climate Crisis?
Finders, Keepers?
Pass-Through as a Test for Market Power: An Application to Solar Subsidies
abstract: We formalize pass-through over-shifting as a simple yet underutilized test for market power. We apply this test in the market for solar energy. Specifically, we estimate the pass-through of solar subsidies to solar system prices using rich micro-level transaction and subsidy data from California. Buyers of solar systems capture nearly the full subsidy, while there is more-than-complete pass-through to lessees. We conclude that solar markets are imperfectly competitive by ruling out alternative explanations for over-shifting and reinforce this conclusion with a test of solar demand curvature. This procedure can serve to detect market power beyond the solar market. (JEL H23, H76, L13, L63, Q42, Q48)
abstract_zh: 我们将传导过度（pass-through over-shifting）形式化，将其作为一种简单却未被充分利用的市场势力检验方法。我们将该检验应用于太阳能市场。具体而言，我们利用加州丰富的微观层面交易数据和补贴数据，估计太阳能补贴向太阳能系统价格的传导情况。太阳能系统的购买者几乎获得了全部补贴，而租赁者则出现了超额传导（more-than-complete pass-through）。通过排除传导过度的其他解释，我们得出结论：太阳能市场并非完全竞争，并通过对太阳能需求曲率的检验强化了这一结论。该方法可用于检测太阳能市场之外的市场势力。（JEL H23, H76, L13, L63, Q42, Q48）

title: Energy Leapfrogging
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Today’s less developed countries (LDCs) have access to energy technologies that did not exist when today’s richer countries were at similar stages of development. Do LDCs therefore consume less energy per capita than rich countries in the past? And is their economic growth associated with a lower growth in energy consumption? Can they “leapfrog” to a lower-carbon economy? I use data on energy consumption, prices, and gross domestic product for 76 countries to estimate the energy intensity of income growth for both current LDCs and industrialized countries in the past. I find that, despite dramatic improvements in energy efficiency, economic growth in LDCs is not less energy-intensive than past growth in industrialized countries. Energy savings from access to more efficient technologies have been offset by other trends, including a shift toward more energy-intensive consumption bundles and compositional changes in industry such as outsourcing. This can have serious implications for energy consumption projections.
abstract_zh: 如今，欠发达国家（LDCs）能够获得在当今发达国家处于相似发展阶段时尚不存在的能源技术。那么，欠发达国家的人均能源消费是否比过去的发达国家更少？它们的经济增长是否与较低的能源消费增长相关联？它们能否“跨越式”地迈向低碳经济？我利用76个国家的能源消费、价格和国内生产总值（GDP）数据，估计了当今欠发达国家以及过去工业化国家收入增长的能源强度。我发现，尽管能源效率有了显著提高，欠发达国家的经济增长并不比过去工业化国家的增长更节能。更高效技术所带来的节能效果，被其他趋势所抵消，包括向能源密集型消费组合的转变，以及外包等产业结构的组成性变化。这可能对能源消费预测产生严重影响。

title: Vehicle Scrappage and Gasoline Policy
abstract: We estimate the sensitivity of scrap decisions to changes in used car values and show how this “scrap elasticity” produces emissions leakage under fuel efficiency standards, a process known as the Gruenspecht effect. We first estimate the effect of gasoline prices on used vehicle values and scrappage of vehicles with different fuel economies. We then estimate the scrap elasticity itself, which we find to be −0.7. When applied in a model of fuel economy standards, 13–16 percent of the expected fuel savings leak away through the used vehicle market. This effect rivals or exceeds the importance of the often-cited mileage rebound effect. (JEL H23, L62, L78, Q35, Q38, Q48, Q58)
abstract_zh: 我们估计了报废决策对二手车价值变化的敏感性，并说明这种“报废弹性”如何在燃油经济性标准下产生排放泄漏，即所谓的Gruenspecht效应。我们首先估计了汽油价格对二手车价值以及不同燃油经济性车辆报废率的影响。随后，我们估计报废弹性本身，发现其为−0.7。将其应用于燃油经济性标准模型时，预期燃油节省的13%–16%会通过二手车市场泄漏掉。这一效应与常被提及的里程反弹效应相当，甚至更大。（JEL H23, L62, L78, Q35, Q38, Q48, Q58）

title: What Is the Optimal Speed Limit on Freeways?
Investment Treaties and Hydrocarbon Taxation in Developing Countries
venue: Critical Issues in Taxation and Development

title: Resource Extraction Contracts Under Threat of Expropriation: Theory and Evidence
venue: The Review of Economics and Statistics
abstract: We use fiscal data on 2,468 oil extraction agreements in 38 countries to study tax contracts between resource-rich countries and independent oil companies. We analyze why expropriations occur and what determines the degree of oil price exposure of host countries. With asymmetric information about a country's expropriation cost, even optimal contracts feature expropriations. Near linearity in the oil price of real-world hydrocarbon contracts also helps to explain expropriations. We show theoretically and verify empirically that oil price insurance provided by tax contracts is increasing in a country's cost of expropriation and decreasing in its production expertise. The timing of actual expropriations is consistent with our model.
abstract_zh: 我们利用38个国家2,468份石油开采协议的财政数据，研究资源富集国家与独立石油公司之间的税收合同。我们分析了征收（expropriation）发生的原因，以及决定东道国石油价格敞口程度的因素。在一国征收成本存在信息不对称的情况下，即使是最优合同也会出现征收现象。现实世界中碳氢化合物合同对石油价格近似线性的特征，也有助于解释征收现象。我们从理论上证明并通过实证加以验证：税收合同所提供的油价保险，随一国征收成本的上升而增加，随其生产专业能力的提高而减少。实际征收的时间安排与我们的模型相一致。

title: Scale and Transfers in International Emissions Offset Programs
Do Property Rights Lead to Sustainable Catch Increases?
abstract: Individual transferable quotas (ITQs) assign property rights in fisheries by granting individual fishers a tradable share of the total allowable catch (TAC). ITQs were originally proposed to enhance profitability and safety, but may also provide incentives for more conservation-minded fishing practices. Indeed, recent empirical evidence shows a reduction in the likelihood of stock collapse and a threefold increase in catches two decades after ITQ implementation. Yet these spectacular catch increases follow modest 20% reductions in reported catches. We used standard fisheries models to analyze whether these catch trends are consistent with the theory underlying conservation benefits from property rights. We find that it appears unlikely that catch increases are attributable to ITQs alone. Improved catch reporting systems are often enacted concurrent with ITQs and may plausibly explain sustained catch increases. The existence of this alternative explanation warrants caution about claims that property rights are the cause of sustainable catch gains.
abstract_zh: 个别可转让配额（ITQs）通过授予个体渔民可交易的总允许捕捞量（TAC）份额，在渔业中界定产权。ITQs最初提出的目的是提高盈利能力和安全性，但它也可能为更注重保护的捕捞行为提供激励。事实上，近期的实证证据显示，在ITQ实施二十年后，种群崩溃的可能性下降，捕捞量增长了三倍。然而，这些惊人的捕捞量增长是在报告捕捞量仅小幅下降20%之后出现的。我们利用标准渔业模型，分析这些捕捞趋势是否与产权带来保护效益的理论相一致。我们发现，捕捞量的增长似乎不太可能仅归因于ITQs。与ITQs同时实施的捕捞报告系统改进，很可能解释了捕捞量的持续增长。这一替代性解释的存在，使我们对于产权是持续捕捞增长原因的论断保持谨慎。

title: Unintended Consequences from Nested State & Federal Regulations: The Case of the Pavley Greenhouse-Gas-per-Mile Limits
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Fourteen U.S. states recently pledged to adopt limits on greenhouse gases (GHGs) per mile of light-duty automobiles. Previous analyses predicted this action would significantly reduce emissions from new cars in these states, but ignored possible offsetting emissions increases from policy-induced adjustments in new car markets in other (non-adopting) states and in the used car market. Such offsets (or "leakage") reflect the fact that the state-level effort interacts with the national corporate average fuel economy (CAFE) standard: the state-level initiative effectively loosens the national standard and gives automakers scope to profitably increase sales of high-emissions automobiles in non-adopting states. In addition, although the state-level effort may well spur the invention of fuel-and emissions-saving technologies, interactions with the federal CAFE standard limit the nationwide emissions reductions from such advances. Using a multi-period numerical simulation model, we find that 70-80 percent of the emissions reductions from new cars in adopting states are offset by emissions leakage. This research examines a particular instance of a general issue of policy significance -namely, problems from "nested" federal and state environmental regulations. Such nesting implies that similar leakage difficulties are likely to arise under several newly proposed state-level initiatives.
abstract_zh: 十四个美国州近期承诺采用每英里温室气体（GHG）排放限值，适用于轻型汽车。先前分析预测，这一行动将显著减少这些州新车的排放，但忽视了在政策影响下，其他（未采用该限值的）州的新车市场和二手车市场可能产生的抵消性排放增加。这种抵消（即“泄漏”）反映了这样一个事实：州级行动与全国企业平均燃油经济性（CAFE）标准相互作用，州级举措实际上放松了全国标准，使汽车制造商有空间在未采用该限值的州有利可图地增加高排放汽车的销售。此外，尽管州级行动可能确实促进了节能减排技术的发明，但与联邦CAFE标准的相互作用限制了这些进步带来的全国性减排效果。利用多期数值模拟模型，我们发现，采用该限值的州中新车产生的排放减少，有70%–80%被排放泄漏所抵消。本研究考察了一个具有普遍政策意义问题的特定案例，即联邦与州环境法规“嵌套”所带来的问题。这种嵌套意味着，在若干新提议的州级举措下，也可能出现类似的泄漏困难。

title: Fuelling Growth: What Drives Energy Demand in Developing Countries?
abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between energy demand, economic growth and prices in 24 non-OECD countries and three sectors from 1978-2003. We estimate linear and non-linear income andprice elasticities, using time fixed effects to control for unobserved dynamic effects such as technological change. We also test for asymmetric responses to price changes. The analysis leads to the following conclusions. First, the income elasticity of energy demand is high and increases with income, both on the country and the sector level. Second, energy demand is more responsive to end-use price than international oil price changes. Third, the price elasticity of energy demand increases with the price level. This result, driven by the residential and agricultural sector, is new to the literature for developing countries, and is consistent with the hypothesis of stronger responsiveness to high energy prices. Finally, we find that after including time fixed effects, allowing for price asymmetry adds little to the results.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了1978年至2003年间24个非经合组织（非OECD）国家及三个部门的能源需求、经济增长与价格之间的关系。我们估计了线性和非线性的收入弹性与价格弹性，并使用时间固定效应来控制技术进步等不可观测的动态效应。我们还检验了价格变动时的非对称反应。分析得出以下结论。第一，无论是在国家层面还是在部门层面，能源需求的收入弹性都很高，并且随收入上升而增大。第二，能源需求对终端使用价格的反应，强于对国际石油价格变动的反应。第三，能源需求的价格弹性随价格水平的上升而增大。这一结果主要由居民部门和农业部门驱动，对发展中国家的文献而言是全新的，并与对高能源价格反应更为强烈的假说相一致。最后，我们发现，在纳入时间固定效应之后，允许价格非对称性对结果的增益很小。

title: Learning-by-Doing and the Optimal Solar Policy in California
abstract: Much policy attention has been given to promote fledgling energy technologies that promise to reduce our reliance onfossilfuels. These policies often aim to correct market failures, such as environmental externalities and learning-by-doing (LBD). We examine the implications of the assumption that LBD exists, quantifying the market failure due to LBD. We develop a model of technological advancement based on LBD and environmental market failures to examine the economically efficient level of subsidies in California’s solar photovoltaic market. Under central-case parameter estimates, including nonappropriable LBD, we find that maximizing net social benefits implies a solar subsidy schedule similar in magnitude to the recently implemented California Solar Initiative. This result holds for a wide range of LBD parameters. However, with no LBD, the subsidies cannot be justified by the environmental externality alone.
abstract_zh: 许多政策关注都致力于推动尚处于起步阶段的能源技术，这些技术有望减少我们对化石燃料的依赖。此类政策通常旨在纠正市场失灵，例如环境外部性和边干边学（learning-by-doing，LBD）。我们检验了边干边学存在这一假设的含义，并量化了边干边学所导致的市场失灵。我们构建了一个基于边干边学和环境市场失灵的技术进步模型，以考察加州太阳能光伏市场中经济上有效率的补贴水平。在包括不可占用型边干边学在内的中心情景参数估计下，我们发现，使净社会福利最大化意味着一条补贴路径，其规模与近期实施的加州太阳能计划（California Solar Initiative）相近。这一结论在边干边学参数的广泛取值范围内都成立。然而，若不存在边干边学，仅凭环境外部性无法为这些补贴提供正当性。

title: An Options Approach to Investment in a Hydrogen Infrastructure
